explication: OpenBLAS is an optimized BLAS library that also includes LAPACK. A caller uses the CBLAS/BLAS interfaces to request vector, matrix-vector, or matrix-matrix operations; LAPACK interfaces provide higher-level factorizations and solves. Drivers and compute kernels implement the numerical work, with CPU-specific variants supporting optimization across architectures. Runtime components provide threading, memory management, and configuration. The README establishes the product capabilities; source excerpts are incomplete, so implementation links not directly demonstrated are marked unverified.
